method.fpsDefinition: Animation-loop FPS: actual app.frame calls driven by requestAnimationFrame in headless Chromium. Bench throughput/GPU estimates are reported separately and are not displayed FPS.
method.rendering: Headless hardware WebGPU if available; adapter details recorded. Headless timing is not a physical monitor refresh measurement.
